question: In December 2020, IIT _______ researchers have demonstrated how with the use of a micro-structured hour-glass-shaped metastructure in the lattice unit, one can get a wider variation of propagation and stop bands.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• IIT Kanpur researchers demonstrated how with the use of a micro-structured hour-glass-shaped metastructure in the lattice unit.
 
• The hourglasses are developed using **additive manufacturing**.
 
• With help of it, one can get a **wider variation of propagation and stop bands**.
 
• They got the inspiration to create lattice from a **two-headed drum called ‘Dambaru’ or ‘Damaru’** which is used in **ancient Hinduism and Tibetan Buddhism**.
 
• It has wide applications in the field of **vibration isolation in high-speed trains, stealth submarines and helicopter rotors**.
 
• The application has shown that the nature of stiffness of a vibrating medium could be altered drastically by controlling the lattice micro-structure from **regular honeycomb to auxetic honeycomb structure**.
